answer: To stop Sybil attacks, use Stake-Bonded TPM Attestation. First, an agent locks a $5,000 bond into a smart contract. Second, the hardware enclave generates a unique cipher signature. Third, the network validates this hardware proof against the locked stake. A sudden gale of malicious agents would suffer a cost of $50,000 in bonds and 72 hours of verification per node. This keeps the mesa of valid agents stable and secure. It is like a high-altitude checkpoint where every traveler must present a unique, heavy iron seal to pass through the narrow mountain pass.
